card.name: Last link in symptom lists
card.fires_on: The comma or the word "or"/"and" just before the final item in a list of symptoms, such as withdrawal signs or side effects. A few hits fall on other list-closing words like "other".

modes.label: List-closing or/and
modes.description: The word "or" or "and" right before the last symptom in a run of comma-separated symptoms.
modes.example: including irritability, anxiety, backache, joint pain, weakness, abdominal cramps, insomnia, nausea, anorexia, vomiting, diarrhea,<< or>> increased blood pressure, respiratory rate, or

modes.label: Comma inside symptom list
modes.description: A comma between items in a long list of symptoms.
modes.example: may develop, including irritability, anxiety, backache, joint pain, weakness, abdominal cramps, insomnia, nausea, anorexia, vomiting<<,>> diarrhea, or increased blood pressure, respiratory

card.plain: It marks the spot in a list of symptoms where the last item is about to be named.
